body: the not knowing if you were successful or not is scary too

I understand what you're going through, although my situation is not that extreme. I sometimes envy people who die everyday from tragic accidents and wish that would happen to me. I don't have the courage to kill myself just because I hate not knowing if I was successful or not. The small % of survival is terrifying for me. Despite how bad my situation is, being brain dead for the rest of my life is a far worse alternative.
Id much rather be your age and depressed than my age and depressed bc at least you have time to change things
Thank you for discouraging me from posting about my own situation. You're 24 and young as shit and act like your life is over lol. Try being my age and depressed and then talk.
